sections.text: مقدمة

This pump is used to forwarding 
 solar fuel oil from large tank of station to unit tank

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which 
 must be carried out every month as indicated by M1 in the above title block.

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. شادي غازي واختباره 
 مدير الصيانة م. عبد الرحمن نصار ومراجعته بالصيانة 
 المدير العام : م. عمران عبد الحميد شعيب 
 approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector و
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 المدير العام ومنسق MPIS المعتمد من قبل المهندس. 
 Mohamed Nagieb INSP. And quality control head sector

الاحتياطات

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل و 
 يجب أن يحمل موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون فئة السلامة المناسبة

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves

sections.text: Pump out of operation

Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed)

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)

Check bolt fixation then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed)

Clean external part with compressed 
 air

Adjust glands for leaking then 
 re-packing it (if it is needed)
